claim.claim-text: 2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the first selected transaction output is an output of a first spending transaction, and the second selected transaction output is an output of a second spending transaction distinct from the first spending transaction.
3. The method according to claim 2, wherein:

the first unlocking script comprises fields of the first transaction, fields of the first selected transaction, and fields of the second spending transaction; and the first locking script comprises a first comparison of extracted fields of the first transaction and a second comparison of extracted fields of the first spending transaction.

4. The method according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the first set of constraints is distinct from the second set of constraints and distinct from constraints on a transaction input of the first transaction.
5. The method according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the first set of constraints and the second set of constraints each comprise a common set of constraints.

6. The method according to any of claims 1 to 5, wherein a constraint on the locking script of the spending transaction requires that, for the spending transaction to be valid, the locking script of the spending transaction includes reference to at least one field of the spending transaction.

7. The method according to any of claims 1 to 5, wherein a constraint on the locking script requires that, for the spending transaction to be valid, the locking script of the spending transaction include a copy of a portion of the first locking script and/or a copy of a portion of the second locking script.

8. The method of claim 1, wherein the first set of constraints and/or the second set of constraints comprises a hash of a portion of the first locking script and/or a hash of a portion of the second locking script, and/or a constraint on a size of a portion of the first locking script and/or a size of a portion of the second locking script.
9. The method of claim 1, wherein the first set of constraints and/or the second set of constraints comprise an optional reference to input data.
10. The method of claim 1, wherein each of a plurality of outputs of the first transaction is constrained by a different constraint applied to outputs of the plurality of outputs.

a processor; and memory including executable instructions that, as a result of execution by the processor, causes the system to perform the computer-implemented method according to any of claims 1 to 10.

12. A non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having stored thereon executable instructions that, as a result of being executed by a processor of a computer system, cause the computer system to at least perform the computer-implemented method according to any of claims 1 to 10.
